verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS AI customer-support platform like Lorikeet, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never mentions self-hosted, on-premise, or customer-deployed options. Trust items (Vanta certifications, zero-data-retention agreements, customer isolation) are related security controls, not self-hosting, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
